entry.name: fbinshift~
entry.digest: Frequency domain frequency shifter for pfft~
entry.description: The fbinshift~ object implements a frequency-domain frequency shifter that can be used inside a patch loaded by a pfft~ object.

arguments.name: frequency-shift
arguments.description: A numerical argument will be used as the frequency shift in Hertz. The default is zero.

arguments.name: frequency-shift
arguments.description: Integer inputs are converted to floating-point values and used as the frequency shift in Hertz. The default is zero.

messages.name: ft2
messages.description: In rightmost inlet: a float in the right inlet will be used as a frequency amount in Hertz by which the complex (real + imaginary) input signal will be shifted.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: The signal present at the left inlet is the real part of a frequency-domain signal coming from aobject inside a.In middle inlet: The signal input to the middle inlet is the imaginary part of a frequency-domain signal coming from aobject inside a. Both real and imaginary inputs must be connected for theto work.
